WITH player_avgs AS (
  SELECT 
    batting_postseason.player_id, 
    player.bats, 
    AVG(batting_postseason.double) as avg_doubles 
  FROM batting_postseason 
  JOIN player ON batting_postseason.player_id = player.player_id 
  WHERE batting_postseason.double IS NOT NULL 
  GROUP BY batting_postseason.player_id, player.bats
), 
overall_avg_calc AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_doubles) as overall_avg FROM player_avgs
), 
player_indices AS (
  SELECT 
    pa.player_id, 
    pa.bats, 
    pa.avg_doubles, 
    pa.avg_doubles / oac.overall_avg as idx 
  FROM player_avgs pa 
  CROSS JOIN overall_avg_calc oac
), 
hand_avg_indices AS (
  SELECT bats, AVG(idx) as hand_avg_idx FROM player_indices GROUP BY bats
) 
SELECT 
  pi.player_id, 
  pi.bats, 
  pi.avg_doubles, 
  pi.idx, 
  pi.idx - hai.hand_avg_idx as diff 
FROM player_indices pi 
JOIN hand_avg_indices hai ON (pi.bats = hai.bats OR (pi.bats IS NULL AND hai.bats IS NULL)) 
WHERE pi.bats IS NOT NULL 
ORDER BY diff DESC NULLS LAST 
LIMIT 10
